scenario.narrative: SYNTHETIC: a drone sighting closes runway 17C at DFW from T+1 to T+16 min while AAL2335 is on approach.

closure.cause: Drone sighting within 2 NM of the runway threshold; runway closed until cleared

messages.reason: S22-A1 has the earliest slot after the 15.9-minute closure, 0.3 min knock-on and 0.21 min wake margin, while S34-A1 gives similar margin at 0.2 min knock-on. DIVERT-ACT removes the arrival entirely and reduces the arrival rate below the 33/hr cap.
red_lines: No landing slot may fall inside the runway 17C closure window (0.7 to 15.9 min).
Wake margin must be at least 0.1 min; S32-A1 (0.06) and S28-A1 (0.11) are the thinnest options.
Arrival throughput must not exceed the 33/hr arrival cap during the closure recovery.

messages.reason: S22-A1 keeps the largest landing fuel margin among holds (19.1 min) with the lowest hold fuel (720 kg) and 36 missed pax, though turbulence is 0.5. DIVERT-ACT strands 113 pax and should be a last resort.
red_lines: Fuel margin must stay above the legal minimum with the 45 min reserve intact
Hold fuel above 1200 kg or a fuel margin below 7.1 min is not acceptable
No divert unless fuel margin falls below the legal minimum on the current hold

messages.reason: All landing options use gate A1 instead of planned gate A6 (gate_change 1) and add overtime; S22-A1 minimises overtime at 10 min and departure delay at 12 min, while DIVERT-ACT adds 180 min departure delay and carries no overtime.
red_lines: Reject any option with overtime_min above 22 min
Reject any option with departure_delay_min above 24 min unless DIVERT-ACT is the only legal alternative

messages.reason: S22-A1 lands at T+22, after the 17C closure ends at T+15.9, and its knock_on_min is 0.3 with window_load 0.58 under the cap. Its wake_margin_min of 0.21 is valid and it is among the lowest-delay options.
red_lines: No landing on 17C before T+15.9 while the closure is active
No slot with wake_margin_min below validator minimum

messages.reason: S22-A1 has the lowest holding fuel of the landing options at 720 kg and a fuel margin of 19.1 min above minimum, with the lowest landing cost at 39.9. Its turbulence of 0.5 is higher than the 0.15 alternatives, but this is acceptable against the fuel and divert costs.
red_lines: Do not accept any option with fuel_margin_min below the legal minimum
Do not accept a divert, which strands 113 connecting passengers

messages.reason: S22-A1 lands earliest at T+22 with overtime 10 min and departure delay 12 min, the lowest ground burden among the landing options. It still forces a gate change from A6 to A1 and costs more than DIVERT's 0 overtime, but DIVERT's 180 min departure delay is much worse.
red_lines: departure_delay_min above 24 min
overtime_min above 22 min

ATC.detail: Wake margin 13 s behind leader, followers pushed 0.3 min, 19/33 in the hour

PILOT.detail: Lands with 19 min above minimum fuel
Severe turbulence (index 0.9) on final at T+16

GROUND.detail: A6 occupied T+10 to T+55; needs T+10 to T+70 incl. buffer
